connect.securityText: After you approve, the agent receives an active API key with full control of your account's YAAPS reports: creating reports, viewing metadata and versions, changing titles, enabling, disabling, and permanently deleting them. Access remains active until you revoke the key in Settings. The key cannot sign in to the dashboard, change passkeys, or access your browser session.

dashboard.eyebrow: Install the skill. Ask your agent to publish.
featureTexts: Install the YAAPS Skill once and use it with Codex, Claude, or another Agent Skills-compatible AI.
When the report is ready, your agent returns a link you can open in a browser or send to anyone who needs it.
Ask for a change and your agent can publish a new version. The link you already shared keeps working.
dashboard.heading: Your agent made a report. Now it can share it.
dashboard.intro: Add the YAAPS Skill to Codex, Claude, or another compatible AI. Then ask it to publish a report in ordinary language and it gives you a link anyone can open.
dashboard.nextHeading: Reports do not stay online forever
dashboard.nextText: Reports expire after seven days by default. You can choose another expiry, stop sharing, or delete a report at any time.
dashboard.securityHeading: People who get the link see only the report.
dashboard.securityText: The link does not give them access to your YAAPS account or other reports. YAAPS also blocks scripts, forms, embedded pages, and network requests.

docs.authenticationText: Create an API key in Settings and store it in your application's secret environment. Send it with every authenticated request as a Bearer token. The full key is shown only once, so do not place it in source code, logs, or chat messages.

endpointDescriptions.addVersion: Publish a new version without changing the report's main link.
endpointDescriptions.create: Publish a new report from one complete HTML document.
endpointDescriptions.delete: Permanently delete a report and all of its versions.
endpointDescriptions.inspect: Get the details of one report owned by your account.
endpointDescriptions.list: List the reports owned by your account.
endpointDescriptions.update: Change the title or start and stop sharing the report.
endpointDescriptions.versions: List every version of a report.

docs.endpointsIntro: Use these operations to publish reports, add immutable versions, control availability, and delete reports. Each API key can access only reports owned by its account.
docs.errorText: Every error includes a stable code that API clients can handle and a short explanation of what went wrong.
docs.heading: Build with the YAAPS API
docs.intro: Publish and manage self-contained HTML reports over HTTP. Use the live reference below to inspect the schema, try authenticated operations, or generate a client.
docs.openApiText: View the complete API schema or use it to generate a client.
docs.quickStartIntro: Set your YAAPS base URL and API key, then send one complete HTML document in the request body.
docs.redocText: Browse a clean, searchable reference generated from the live specification.
docs.securityText: Anyone with the link can open the report. YAAPS blocks scripts, form submissions, frames, plugins, external resource loads, network requests, and same-origin access.
docs.swaggerText: Inspect requests and try authenticated API operations interactively.
